caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate object placed centrally on a plain, light tan background. The object is a small, decorative vessel with a handle, resembling an inkwell, predominantly colored in a rich purple hue. The body of the vessel features raised, curvilinear and geometric patterns in darker purple and black, providing texture and visual interest. The vessel has a golden or brass-colored lid with a segmented design. Two thin, stick-like objects with gray, frayed ends protrude from the top opening, appearing to be small brushes or quills. There are no additional elements or objects in the composition, and the artist's signature "John Trecartin" appears in small letters in the lower right corner.
title: Lamp
